body: I freeze, my heart pounding in my chest. The sight of the animals behind the depot is unsettling, and I feel a surge of instinctual fear. I notice their eyes fixed on me, their movements slow and deliberate. I realize that my impulse is rooted in a deep-seated fear of being caught or harmed. I think about all the dangers that could come with approaching them. My mind starts racing, and I feel a sense of panic rising up.
